basis: Standard API-equivalent estimates, not subscription charges, provider-reported spending or invoices. No Batch, Flex, fast mode, ultrafast, regional or negotiated adjustments. This additive evidence records three models the pricing pages listed by 2026-11-18 that the table did not price, so usage on them counted as missing: GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol, added to OpenAI's standard table on 2026-11-17, and Gemini 4 Neon, added to Google's page on 2026-11-18. Each OpenAI model page lists one model ID and no snapshot, and says: for requests with more than 272K input tokens, input and cache rates double and output costs 1.5 times the short-context rate for the full request; the standard table prints those long-context rates. The tables' cache-write columns are not compared, as in model-pricing-2026-11-07.json. Gemini 4 Neon is paid tier only, prints one input rate for every modality and no prompt-size tier, and caches implicitly only. The rates are flat and carry no dated change: no usage under these IDs predates them. pageNormalizedSha256 is the SHA-256 of each page's text as scripts/provider-contract-lib.mjs normalizes it. Earlier evidence files are retained unchanged.
longContextQuote: Short context: ≤272K input tokens. Long context: >272K input tokens.
